analysis.title: Americas Consumer Staples: NielsenIQ First Take: Sales growth accelerates sequentially across Food & HPC
key_insights: Total store sales rose +3% in the latest quad-week ending 11/14/26, with growth slightly accelerating in the latest 2 weeks vs the prior 2 weeks.
Grocery, Household Care, Health & Beauty Care, Seafood and Frozen led department growth, while Deli, Meat and Alcohol declined y/y.
HPC sales growth accelerated to +5.5% in the latest quad-week vs +3.9% last month, with higher price growth and slightly lower volume growth. Sales on promotion were up +10bps YoY.

PG and CL posted +MSD sales growth on both volume and price. CHD and KMB (standalone) were volume-led, though KMB moderated sequentially. KVUE (now part of KMB) accelerated with volumes at +HSD levels on price investments. CLX lagged the HPC peer group.
Packaged Food sales improved to -0.2% in the latest quad-week vs -1.3% last month, on higher volumes. HRL and TSN accelerated on volume, MDLZ on price, HSY and KHC on both price and volume.

Food decelerators on a 4-week basis were SFD (lower prices), GIS and OFRM (lower volumes), and CAG (lower volumes and prices). On a 12-week basis HRL, KHC and MDLZ accelerated while CAG, GIS, HSY, OFRM, SFD and TSN decelerated.

Non-alc beverage categories were mixed on a 2-wk vs 4-wk basis. Coconut water, sparkling water and bottled water accelerated. Energy drinks, CSDs, sports drinks and RTD tea decelerated, and RTD coffee was stable.
By company, 4-week $ sales accelerated vs last month for MNST (ex-Bang) +6.4%, KO +10.2%, KDP +4.1% and PEP +2.3%. COCO (+10.8% vs +14.6%) and CELH decelerated.
Alcohol: spirits and beer decelerated on a 2-wk basis, while FMB/cider/seltzer and wine were stable. Company 4-week trends improved for STZ, TAP, BF and SAM, though TAP, BF and SAM remain negative.
Tobacco: cigarette $ sales were -1.0% for 2 wks vs -0.8% for 4 wks, broadly stable. MO, IMB and BAT improved on a 4-week basis while PM decelerated to +0.5% from +4.8%. E-cig was -10.8% for 2 wks.
Private label $ share change at total store level moderated to -0.3% on R4wk at 11/14/26 vs +0.3% a year earlier, consistent with branded share recovery.

market_movers.rationale: R4wk sales +5.5% vs +3.9% last month on volume +3.4% and price +2.1%.
R4wk sales +5.0% vs +3.7% last month, with volume +2.0% and price +3.0%.
4-wk sales growth decelerated to +8.1% from +8.0% last month on R4wk, with 2-wk growth slowing to +5.3% weekly.
4-wk $ sales +0.5% vs +4.8% last month, weekly trend turning negative.
Sales -1.6% in R4wk, decelerated on lower volumes and lower prices.
R4wk sales -1.6% vs -0.2% last month on lower volumes.

sector_views.rationale: Sales growth accelerated to +5.5% in the L4wk, led by PG and CL.
Sales improved to -0.2% from -1.3%, but several names (GIS, CAG, OFRM, SFD) decelerated.
Mixed category trends, with KO, PEP, KDP and MNST improving at the company level.
Category sales still negative with spirits and beer decelerating.
Cigarette declines stable, with company trends mixed.

earnings_insights: No earnings were reported. The data are NielsenIQ retail scanner trends for the 4 weeks ending 11/14/26, which are read-throughs for next quarterly prints.
risk_factors: NielsenIQ FVM data excludes some channels and alcohol data excludes Costco, so it may not fully reflect company-reported sales.
Some HPC acceleration is price-led with volume slowing, which could signal elasticity risk.
Weak food volumes for GIS, CAG, OFRM and Post persist.
charts_described: Exhibit 1 shows weekly sales growth by department for weeks ending 10/24/26 to 11/14/26, with L4wk Grocery +5%, Household Care +5%, Health & Beauty Care +4%, Alcohol -1%, Meat -2%, Deli -2%, Total Store +3%.
Exhibit 3 shows rolling 4-wk private label $ share change, with Total Store at -0.3% at 11/14/26 vs +0.3% at 11/15/25.
Exhibit 6 shows beverage category $ sales growth by L2wk/L4wk, with Coconut Water +20.3% L2wk and Tea - Liquid -33.9% L2wk.
